ORAL ORDER 1.

This Criminal Appeal preferred under Section 378 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 against the judgment and order of acquittal dated 08.08.2013 rendered by learned Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Court No. 6, Ahmedabad in Criminal Case No. 4111/2010 under the provisions of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.

sentences.text: 2. This Appeal is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat.

The withdrawal / settlement pursis is signed by APP Shri Utvij Oza, appellant himself and learned advocate for the appellant.
All the concerned are R/CR.A/781/2014 ORDER present in person before this Lok Adalat, and the pursis is counter signed by learned APP and respective learned advocates.

5. In view of the withdrawal / compromise pursis of the parties, this Appeal stands disposed of.
The respondent No.1 is directed to pay a sum of Rs. 3,000/- (Rupees Three thousand only) towards litigation cost; as agreed between the parties.
